name: bbc-automation
description: BBC Sport automation using Playwright + Cucumber + TypeScript + Allure

scripts.test: npx cucumber-js tests/features --require-module ts-node/register --require steps/**/*.ts --require support/**/*.ts --format json:./reports/cucumber-report.json --format progress
scripts.test:report: npx cucumber-js tests/features --require-module ts-node/register --require steps/**/*.ts --format json:./reports/cucumber-report.json
